title: Context challenge
description: The data of a CONTEXT_REQUIRED error or a preflight result, as the context document defines it: why the attempt could not proceed, in the producer's words, and a JSON Schema of the context object to supply on the next attempt. The schema is ordinary JSON Schema 2020-12: oneOf branches with a title each for alternatives, required for values needed together, writeOnly on secrets, and a property description for where a person obtains a value. It describes the context requested for one attempt, not permission to disclose anything else. Acquisition, trust, storage and retry decisions belong to the caller.

message.description: Why the attempt could not proceed, in the producer's words, for a person to read.

schema.description: A JSON Schema 2020-12 schema, in object form, of the context object to supply on the next attempt. The context document defines the conventions it uses and the oauth2 annotation an application may act on.
